# SLOs and alerts

<!-- Generated by scripts/slos.py from the SLOs defined there. Do not edit by hand. -->

What Pitwall promises the people watching the pit wall, measured from the services' own
metrics. Each SLO's error budget is what it may miss; the alerts fire on how fast that
budget is being spent, not on single bad moments.

| SLO | Objective | Promise | Error budget, 30 days | Pages |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [telemetry-freshness](runbooks/telemetry-freshness.md) | 99.0% | 99% of car telemetry reaches the pit wall within 500 ms of being sent | 7.2 h | yes |
| [board-freshness](runbooks/board-freshness.md) | 99.0% | 99% of timing-board updates go out within 1 s of the oldest event in them | 7.2 h | yes |
| [ingest-validity](runbooks/ingest-validity.md) | 99.9% | 99.9% of events pass the schema (the rest are dead-lettered) | 43 min | yes |
| [api-availability](runbooks/api-availability.md) | 99.5% | 99.5% of pit-wall API requests succeed | 3.6 h | yes |
| [link-catch-up](runbooks/link-catch-up.md) | 99.0% | 99% of trackside link outages are caught up within 60 s of the link returning | 7.2 h | no, tickets only |

A budget is how long every event could be bad; it can as well be spent as a long stretch
of a few late ones. A laptop's Prometheus keeps 3 days, so the dashboards show what is
left of the budget over 3 days.

## When the budget burns

Google's SRE workbook, chapter 5: alert when the budget burns several times too fast over
a long window, confirmed over a short one so the alert stops soon after the problem does.

| Severity | Burn rate | Over | Confirmed over | Spends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| page | 14.4x | 1h | 5m | 2% of a 30-day budget |
| page | 6x | 6h | 30m | 5% of a 30-day budget |
| ticket | 3x | 1d | 2h | 10% of a 30-day budget |
| ticket | 1x | 3d | 6h | 10% of a 30-day budget |

## Every alert

| Alert | Severity | After | What it means | Runbook |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PitwallTelemetryFreshnessBudgetPage` | page | burn rate | telemetry-freshness: error budget burning too fast (page) | [telemetry-freshness](runbooks/telemetry-freshness.md) |
| `PitwallTelemetryFreshnessBudgetTicket` | ticket | burn rate | telemetry-freshness: error budget burning too fast (ticket) | [telemetry-freshness](runbooks/telemetry-freshness.md) |
| `PitwallBoardFreshnessBudgetPage` | page | burn rate | board-freshness: error budget burning too fast (page) | [board-freshness](runbooks/board-freshness.md) |
| `PitwallBoardFreshnessBudgetTicket` | ticket | burn rate | board-freshness: error budget burning too fast (ticket) | [board-freshness](runbooks/board-freshness.md) |
| `PitwallIngestValidityBudgetPage` | page | burn rate | ingest-validity: error budget burning too fast (page) | [ingest-validity](runbooks/ingest-validity.md) |
| `PitwallIngestValidityBudgetTicket` | ticket | burn rate | ingest-validity: error budget burning too fast (ticket) | [ingest-validity](runbooks/ingest-validity.md) |
| `PitwallApiAvailabilityBudgetPage` | page | burn rate | api-availability: error budget burning too fast (page) | [api-availability](runbooks/api-availability.md) |
| `PitwallApiAvailabilityBudgetTicket` | ticket | burn rate | api-availability: error budget burning too fast (ticket) | [api-availability](runbooks/api-availability.md) |
| `PitwallLinkCatchUpBudgetTicket` | ticket | burn rate | link-catch-up: error budget burning too fast (ticket) | [link-catch-up](runbooks/link-catch-up.md) |
| `PitwallServiceDown` | page | 1m | {pod} is not answering Prometheus | [service-down](runbooks/service-down.md) |
| `PitwallConsumerLagHigh` | ticket | 2m | {service} is {n} messages behind on {topic} | [consumer-lag](runbooks/consumer-lag.md) |
| `PitwallDeadLetters` | ticket | at once | Events are failing the schema and going to pitwall.deadletter | [ingest-validity](runbooks/ingest-validity.md) |
| `PitwallReplayBehind` | ticket | 2m | The replayer is {time} behind the race's schedule | [consumer-lag](runbooks/consumer-lag.md) |
| `PitwallLinkDown` | page | 1m | The trackside link is down: the factory is getting no data (it is buffered) | [trackside-link](runbooks/trackside-link.md) |
| `PitwallEventsLost` | page | at once | {n} events never reached the factory: data was lost | [trackside-link](runbooks/trackside-link.md) |
| `PitwallUplinkBacklog` | ticket | 5m | {n} trackside events are waiting for the link | [trackside-link](runbooks/trackside-link.md) |
| `PitwallPodRestarting` | ticket | at once | {pod} restarted {n} times in 15 minutes | [service-down](runbooks/service-down.md) |

Pages are for a person now; tickets are for the next working day. On a laptop neither
goes anywhere: they show in Alertmanager and on Grafana's **Pitwall · Race health**.
